titulo: Bigfoot vs The Goatman: Who Won? 😰 #Shorts
titulo_pt: Pé-Grande contra o Homem-Bode: quem venceu?
resumo_pt: Um campista vê o Homem-Bode atacar o acampamento dele de madrugada. O Pé-Grande aparece, segura os chifres do Homem-Bode, quebra um deles e o arremessa no riacho. O Homem-Bode foge mancando. O Pé-Grande vence pela força e deixa o chifre quebrado na barraca do campista, como se tivesse lutado para protegê-lo.
descricao:
One had horns. The other had eight feet of muscle.

Who do you think wins a rematch?

Follow @VeilFrequency for a new horror story every day. Fictional story based on American folklore. Images are AI-generated.
personagens: the narrator is a camper in his thirties with a dark beard, a black beanie and an orange jacket, with a small green tent and a campfire; Bigfoot is eight feet tall, covered in thick reddish-brown fur, with a broad dark face and deep-set eyes; the Goatman is a tall gaunt man-goat with gray fur, curved black horns, a goat's face with yellow slit eyes, and hooves

scenes.text: Bigfoot versus the Goatman. Who wins?
scenes.pt: Pé-Grande contra o Homem-Bode. Quem vence?
scenes.visual: Bigfoot and the Goatman facing each other in a dark forest clearing beside a campfire

scenes.text: I was camping alone when hooves circled my tent.
scenes.pt: Eu estava acampando sozinho quando cascos rodearam minha barraca.
scenes.visual: the camper alone inside a small green tent at night, a shadow with horns on the tent wall

scenes.text: The Goatman ripped the flap open.
scenes.pt: O Homem-Bode rasgou a entrada da barraca.
scenes.visual: the Goatman tearing open the tent flap, yellow slit eyes glaring at the camper

scenes.text: Then the trees behind him cracked.
scenes.pt: Aí as árvores atrás dele estalaram.
scenes.visual: Bigfoot pushing through the trees at the edge of the campfire light

scenes.text: Eight feet of fur stepped into my campfire light.
scenes.pt: Dois metros e meio de pelo entraram na luz da fogueira.
scenes.visual: Bigfoot towering behind the Goatman in the campfire glow

scenes.text: The Goatman lowered his horns and charged.
scenes.pt: O Homem-Bode abaixou os chifres e atacou.
scenes.visual: the Goatman charging horns first at Bigfoot across the campsite

scenes.text: Bigfoot caught him by the horns.
scenes.pt: O Pé-Grande segurou ele pelos chifres.
scenes.visual: Bigfoot gripping the Goatman's curved horns, both straining

scenes.text: One horn snapped like a branch.
scenes.pt: Um chifre quebrou como um galho.
scenes.visual: a black horn breaking off in Bigfoot's hand, the Goatman staggering back

scenes.text: Bigfoot threw him into the creek.
scenes.pt: O Pé-Grande jogou ele no riacho.
scenes.visual: Bigfoot hurling the Goatman into a rocky creek, water splashing in the moonlight
the Goatman limping away into the dark woods with one horn missing

scenes.pt: O Pé-Grande se virou para mim.
scenes.visual: Bigfoot staring down at the terrified camper by the campfire

scenes.text: He dropped the broken horn at my tent.
scenes.pt: Ele largou o chifre quebrado na minha barraca.
scenes.visual: a broken black horn lying in front of the torn green tent

scenes.text: Bigfoot won. He'd been protecting me.
scenes.pt: O Pé-Grande venceu. Ele estava me protegendo.
scenes.visual: Bigfoot walking away into the trees, the camper holding the broken horn by the fire
